name: landing-page-copy-check
description: Draft and check pasted landing page copy for clear messages, proof, calls to action, and common conversion friction. For founders, marketers, and teams improving a homepage, product page, or pricing page. It writes and checks text only, uses copy you paste, never fetches a URL, never changes a live site, and offers no traffic or conversion guarantees.
